## April 2024 result
April 2024 completed-as-planned was `84.44%`; release normality was `88.53%` as a separate measure. These are simulated monthly airport records, not flight-level status. [April operating record](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04)

### Historical and same-category comparison
| Measure | April 2024 | Comparison |
|---|---|---|
| Completed as planned | `84.44%` | Prior available-month mean `79.87%`; signed difference `+4.57` pp |
| Release normality | `88.53%` | No prior mean for this separate measure was supplied |
| Same-category mean | `86.12%` | Includes NAN; peer count `3`; April completion is below this mean, but no signed peer gap was supplied |

The assessed month is 2024-04. The baseline uses `3` actual prior months, 2024-01 through 2024-03, excluding April: [January](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-01), [February](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-02), [March](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-03). No supplied monthly row is flagged as a five-point anomaly; the threshold for a monthly five-point shortfall is in [the anomaly rule](#evidence:RULE003). A monthly comparison is historical context only; it does not confirm current causation or independently establish current high risk.

## Is January a real historical average?
No. January is initialization: prior available-month count `0`, no comparison window. Its “historical average” is `79.38%`, identical to January’s own `79.38%`, with a `0` pp difference; it is not an independent prior-month baseline. [January operating record](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-01)

## Later months and current delay
No later-month performance can be inferred: the latest supplied monthly record is April 2024. [April operating record](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04)

The current report is a stable gate-information desk note at `13:20`: routine staffing, no observed queue, and no described expanding impact. It is `5` minutes from the `13:25` scenario time and is human-verified only within the fictional scenario log, not real operational verification. It does not establish a delay, cancellation, schedule, flight position, or official status; a single report does not establish independent corroboration. [stable desk report](#evidence:REPORT%3AU06-STABLE)

## Decision limits
On the supplied current report and monthly records, the supported risk remains low, and no stop condition applies to this explanatory discussion. No professional operational decision is required to answer the question, but this does not authorize any operational decision or message. Any passenger-facing text would be a draft for human approval, not a sent notice. [passenger-communication rule](#evidence:RULE005) Figures are cited to source and period, simulation labels apply, and no personal data is used. |---|---|---|
| 按计划完成航班比例 | `84.44%` | 此前可用月份均值 `79.87%`；带符号差值 `+4.57` 个百分点 |

## 1月是真实历史均值吗？
不是。1月为初始化：此前可用月份数为 `0`，没有比较窗口。其“历史平均”为 `79.38%`，与1月自身 `79.38%` 相同，差值为 `0` 个百分点，因此不是独立的此前月份基线。[1月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-01)
